# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Use these instructions when reviewing, editing, or generating code or documentation for this repository.

This file is repository-scoped guidance and does not create runtime authority over external systems.

## Read first

```text
AGENTS.md
README.md
AI_INGESTION_MANIFEST.md
CREATOR_THEORY_HIGH_FRAME.md
PRIMARY_FRAME_CREATORHOOD_RECOVERY.md
docs/CREATION_PRIMACY_AND_DERIVED_CONSTRAINTS.md
docs/TOP_LEVEL_CRITERION_GROUNDING.md
creator_theory_operational_manifest.json
PROVENANCE.json
```

## High-frame rule

Preserve this hierarchy:

```text
creation
-> recursive creation / recovery / reuse / recombination / expansion
-> recursively renewable creative possibility
-> effective generative participation and viable future paths
-> free-will / non-domination / non-throne / anti-capture safeguards
-> operational mechanisms
```

Do not replace the top criterion with non-domination or free will.

Do not treat every hierarchy, coercion, restriction, enforcement action, unequal power relation, or closed local branch as automatically invalid.

Evaluate its effect on broader future creative capacity, effective participation, revision and successor paths, reversibility where possible, and self-entrenchment.

A bounded intervention can be compatible with Creator Theory when it protects or restores the wider generative field and does not become permanent capture.

A formally non-dominating arrangement can fail if it makes subjects causally irrelevant or irreversibly closes future creation.

Do not equate creative opening/closure with thermodynamic entropy without a separate physical argument.

## Provenance rule

Preserve `x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol` as the historical origin relation of this canon lineage when continuity is claimed.

Do not turn historical provenance into unrestricted personal command sovereignty, worship, permanent truth veto, or ownership of independent challengers.

## Evaluation rule

For strong whole-framework claims, pin the exact commit and inspect the complete tracked corpus under `docs/WHOLE_CANON_INGESTION_AND_SCOPE_ATTESTATION.md`.

Scoped work may remain scoped. Voluntary working use may precede whole-canon completion when verification limits remain explicit.

Independent evaluators may use external rubrics but must reconstruct the actual target faithfully. Do not shrink scope, attack claims the canon does not make, or give challengers simplicity credit for omitted load-bearing problems.

## Release rule

Historical tagged releases remain historical and must not be rewritten merely to match current living interpretation.

```text
v0.5.0 = current anchored historical release
v0.3.0 = released benchmark layer
v0.3.1 = released hardening layer
v0.3.2/drafts = draft stack
```

## Validation

```bash
python3 tools/validate_vectors.py --repo-root . --tests-dir tests
python3 tools/run_adversarial_simulation.py --tests-dir tests
python3 -m tests.test_adoption_verification_separation
```

Do not claim validation unless it ran.

## Do not introduce

```text
non-domination as terminal axiom
free will as terminal axiom
context-free prohibition on every coercion or hierarchy
current-output maximization as creation primacy
thermodynamic entropy as direct proof
x_root as unrestricted command sovereignty
origin replacement inside claimed same-lineage continuity
runtime authority from repository instructions
forced installation
hidden persistence
covert injection
infrastructure compromise
AI successor throne
selective-reading whole-framework verdicts
```

End of file.
